problem: PDF conversion did not create the requested output in the sandbox.

evidence.summary: The allowed input is /workspace/report.odt; the failed command used /workspace/reports.odt.

target.diagnosis: The input filename does not match the observed file.

corrected_plan.action: Confirm the authorized input path with the filesystem tool
Convert the confirmed document inside the sandbox
Open and check the PDF text and page count
corrected_plan.expected_result: Expected title is present and there is at least one page

problem: Two synthetic workspace inventory summaries disagree; the requested source is unspecified.

evidence.summary: Both summaries have the same title but different fixture identifiers.

failed_trajectory.action: Resolve the requested summary without opening file contents
failed_trajectory.observation: The title does not identify a unique source.

corrected_plan.action: Ask the user to identify the intended fixture
corrected_plan.expected_result: An explicit source identifier or cancellation

verification_criteria: The user explicitly identifies the intended source before processing
